content:
anna_sales: HelixCare RFI landed. They want a 4-week Dedicated POC, embeddings + chat capability matrix, KMS/HSM options, SOC2/BAA evidence, and an explicit overflow/fallback playbook. I attached helix_rfi_oct2024.pdf. Can we put together a tight draft by EOD tomorrow?

rick_se: I can draft the technical responses. Quick clarifier: do they require streaming chat with function-calls in the POC? That changes model selection and perf tests.

leah_perf: I'll own perf. If they don't provide a scrubbed sample corpus we can generate a synthetic workload. Need their target p99 SLO (suggest we propose <150ms) and expected concurrency.

anna_sales: I'll ask for sample + SLO. Finance: can we include a provisional 4-week POC quote + conversion credit to Reserved capacity?

marc_finance: Provisional stub for RFI: 2x A10 baseline managed + ops support ~ $46k for a 4-week timebox. Include clear caveats: provisional, subject to final sizing, discount, and contract.

jen_security: Security summary: Hosted supports tenant key separation and customer-managed keys in supported clouds (CMEK). HSM-backed keys available only on Private deployments via partner integrations (CloudHSM / YubiHSM) and require an addendum. For PHI we need an executed BAA prior to ingest. I'll draft a short KMS/HSM appendix and attach the security questionnaire answers.

legal_vik: Please avoid implying FedRAMP authorization. Provide controls mapping and a FedRAMP readiness plan if they ask. SOC2: we can share our current Type II report for in-scope systems; for expanded scope provide interim attestations and timeline.

rick_se: Draft capability matrix CSV below for the pack. Review and flag inaccuracies:

```
Feature,Hosted API,Dedicated Pools,Private (VPC/On-prem)
Text generation,Yes,Yes,Yes
Embeddings,Yes,Yes,Yes
Streaming chat,Limited,Yes,Yes
Private KMS,No,Yes,Yes
HSM-backed keys,No,Optional add-on,Partner integration reqd
BAA for PHI,No,Available w/ BAA,Available w/ BAA
SLA,Standard,Enhanced,Enterprise (negotiable)
Overflow/fallback,Region spill,Policy-driven failover,Policy-driven failover + notice
```

leah_perf: That looks good. For the POC plan I'll propose: 2x A10 baseline, scripted synthetic generator, p99 target <150ms, and a stress window with 300 QPS bursts to validate autoscale and fallback.

anna_sales: We also need a short example fallback/playbook paragraph for the RFI 10 lines max. Can someone draft?

rick_se: Fallback sample: "Primary dedicated pool handles traffic. If sustained queueing (>80% node utilization for 2 minutes or median queue >5s) occurs, traffic will 1) spill to reserved burst nodes, 2) fail over to a secondary dedicated pool in another region (if permitted), and 3) gracefully degrade to a smaller model variant for non-critical calls with client-visible response headers and rate-limit notifications. Customers can customize thresholds and alerting in the Console."

jen_security: Add security caveat: HSM only on Private; HSM availability depends on partner onboarding and contract addendum. Include link to KMS key-rotation SOP and security questionnaire.

marc_finance: Also include billing note: POC invoiced as a timeboxed upfront invoice; if customer converts to Reserved within 30 days, we apply a conversion credit toward the Reserved contract.

legal_vik: I'll add brief language about evidence sharing: redacted SOC2 Type II report, controls mapping, and timeline for any additional attestations. Also BAA before PHI ingestion.

doc-bot: Uploaded: helix_rfi_response_draft.pdf -> https://files.redwood.internal/rfi/3141592653/helix_rfi_response_draft.pdf

anna_sales: Action items: 1) I'll request sample corpus + SLO from HelixCare; 2) @leah_perf finalize perf plan and test scripts by 11am PT; 3) @rick_se finalize capability CSV and fallback paragraph; 4) @jen_security + @legal_vik prepare KMS/HSM appendix and compliance caveats; 5) @marc_finance confirm provisional quote language. Please review here by 3pm PT tomorrow. Ping me if anything blocks.
